escena: SCENE (content production studio at night, Santiago): a wide, low-key view across a dark studio in the middle of a take: the camera is rolling, its monitor plays the shot back and an LED panel has just been dimmed for the next setup. The lens focuses on nothing near: 85mm at f/1.4, everything far out of focus, so the studio becomes large, soft, round bokeh. On the right half, out of focus: the glowing faces of two LED panels and a softbox, the rectangle of an edit monitor showing a video timeline, and the dark silhouette of a cinema camera on a tripod. Deep ink-blue shadows everywhere; the only light is cool blue. No people, no readable screens, no text, no logos.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus edge of a dark edit desk
